observations.body: Christ’s downward movement leads to exaltation. Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus, and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
observations.label: Christ’s downward movement leads to exaltation

payload.posture: Read Philippians 2:5–11 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states christ’s downward movement leads to exaltation. Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus, and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
